instruction: Find the cell with the maximum marks value in row 5 (C5 to F5) and apply a yellow highlight to that cell

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum mark in C5:F5 range and highlighting it with yellow color. The evaluator dynamically finds the cell with max value, verifies it has yellow highlight (FFFFFF00), and ensures other cells in range are not highlighted.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly dynamically finds the maximum value in C5:F5 range (lines 50-63 in calc.py getter)
Getter correctly extracts fill colors for max cell and all other cells in range (lines 72-86)
Metric correctly validates yellow color with proper variants (FFFFFF00, FFFF00, etc.) at lines 33-52
Metric correctly implements partial credit logic: 0.0 if max cell not highlighted, 0.5 if max cell has yellow but others also highlighted, 1.0 if only max cell has yellow (lines 24-60)
Expected values are semantically correct: color=FFFFFF00 (yellow) and only_max_highlighted=true
Postconfig correctly saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure highlighting changes are persisted
Complete coverage: verifies both that max cell has yellow AND that other cells are not highlighted
